questions: Q1: Should the CLI add GOAL to VALID_MODES or create a new command namespace?
Q2: What commands does the hlx goals family need?

answers.answer: New hlx goals command family in src/goals/ directory. VALID_MODES stays unchanged at 5 values. Goals are a separate entity with own API endpoints (POST /api/goals, not POST /api/tickets). The CLI namespace must reflect this separation.
evidence: Goals use separate API endpoints (POST /api/goals, GET /api/goals, etc.)
src/tickets/index.ts: subcommand router pattern applicable to goals family

answers.answer: Four commands for MVP: create (POST /api/goals), list (GET /api/goals with --status filter), get (GET /api/goals/:id), terminate (POST /api/goals/:id/terminate with --outcome). Create accepts --title, --description, --max-children, --require-approval, --repo flags.
evidence: product/product.md SCN-11: 'hlx goals create --title "Automate RMA process" --description "..." with optional --max-children 15'
product/product.md essential feature #14: 'hlx goals create, hlx goals list, hlx goals get, hlx goals terminate'

statement: CLI adds a new hlx goals command family (create, list, get, terminate) in src/goals/ mirroring the src/tickets/ pattern. VALID_MODES is unchanged. Commands hit the separate /api/goals server endpoints. Tertiary scope -- depends on server API being available.
